scope: Amazon India, Flipkart and Myntra; independently evidenced exact selected fragrance variants

acceptance.required: Requested retailer product ID/URL, seller/SKU where supplied, main INR price, image and explicit stock agree
Multiple named fragrances with independent selected 30ml evidence match across all six directed store pairs
acceptance.provenance: Synthetic transformations; includes Love Drunk, Old Money, Fresh Morning, Quiet Garden and Cedar Trail; not captured triples

acceptance.required: Reject wrong scent, brand, 20/30/100ml, EDP/EDT, oil/mist, editions, packs, testers, refills and bundles
Null/missing seller quantity, title/catalog/per-unit quantities cannot create independent Product selected-volume proof
BSON optional unknowns stay unknown; provenance and source binding remain strict; stale prices do not renew identity links
Reject missing/invalid INR prices, anomalies, conflicting observations and explicit unavailable stock; saved Product observations expire after ten minutes
No extra paid hydration/retries; partial store failures preserve other offers; caches/manual links remain intact
Every displayed competitor is independently bound to the exact selected Product variant; listing title is never selected-SKU proof
acceptance.observed: Existing compatibility policy can display listingOnly matches. The passing regression proves this limitation, not milestone compliance.

acceptance.required: Actual captured Search responses contain independently verifiable candidates and produce expected store diagnostics
acceptance.observed: Zero captured live Search fixtures; synthetic parser success does not establish recall

acceptance.required: Captured same-size Product responses agree across the three stores on selected quantity and affirmative formulation/pack declarations
acceptance.observed: Captured Amazon/Flipkart are 30ml and Myntra is 100ml; Amazon oil/pack declarations cannot be silently dropped

acceptance.required: Every retained offer has its own current bound price/stock observation; comparison time cannot renew an old price
acceptance.observed: Retained legacy/manual/search offers lack uniform per-offer observations; ten-minute saved Product checks do not cover all offers

blockers.needed: Actual main Product selected quantity/seller/SKU evidence and compatible declarations for each counterpart, or sufficiently fresh independently validated tracked records; then replace listing-only price certification with a strict Product-evidence gate
blockers.boundary: No selected quantity is invented and no compatibility policy is silently changed by this acceptance report

blockers.needed: One actual sanitized Search response and bounded result diagnostics for the fixed target; no pagination or retries
A versioned per-offer observation/expiry policy with explicit legacy handling; absent historical observation times cannot be reconstructed from offersCheckedAt

exclusions: One-word/reordered/non-ASCII scent naming and unsupported declaration formats are not certified
No new stores or category profiles
User-reported live successes are not new captured fixture evidence

futureLiveBudget.purpose: Capture discovery evidence only; does not authorize an extra Product call or establish selected-SKU proof
